title: Sunitha Raghunath vs Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Builders & another
nature: suit for permanent injunction against construction
one_line_summary: Builder constructing a fourth floor over the common staircase and blocking light and air to plaintiff's house at Bowenpally.
court: Court of the III Junior Civil Judge, City Civil Court, Hyderabad

hearings.outcome: Defendants served; vakalat filed for D1
hearings.order_sheet: Service on defendants complete. Vakalat filed for D1. D2 called absent. For counter in I.A. No. 402 of 2025 and written statement, call on 11.06.2025.
hearings.note: Sunitha injunction (OS 145/25) - Tummala madam checked service and vakalat before anything else, as usual. Siddiqui appeared for the builder (D1). D2 (landowner) absent.

hearings.listed_for: counter in I.A. 402/2025 and written statement
hearings.outcome: Counter and written statement filed by D1
hearings.order_sheet: Counter in I.A. No. 402 of 2025 and written statement filed by D1. D2 set ex parte. For hearing on I.A., call on 13.08.2025.
hearings.note: Sunitha - builder filed counter + WS. Says 4th floor has GHMC permission dated 2024. Our point: permission is for G+3 only, the 4th floor is over the common staircase. Sunitha garu sent photos - construction still going on.

hearings.order_sheet: I.A. heard in part. Call on 15.10.2025.
hearings.note: Sunitha - argued IA for 30 min. Madam asked for the sanctioned plan - builder's counsel said he will produce.

hearings.outcome: Papers returned for defect; sanctioned plan not produced
hearings.order_sheet: Sanctioned plan not produced by D1. Documents filed by plaintiff returned for want of proper index. Call on 09.02.2026.
hearings.note: Sunitha - our additional documents returned because index page numbers didn't match (Tummala madam is strict on this). My fault, Sai fix it. Builder still hasn't produced the plan.

hearings.outcome: Arguments on I.A. concluded; orders reserved
hearings.order_sheet: Arguments on I.A. No. 402 of 2025 heard. Orders reserved. Call on 08.09.2026.
hearings.note: Sunitha - IA arguments done, orders reserved. Builder produced a plan only today, and it shows 'G+3 + headroom'. Our point is strong but she reserves everything, may take months.

hearings.order_sheet: Orders pronounced in I.A. No. 402 of 2025. For the reasons recorded separately, the I.A. is dismissed. No costs. For plaintiff's evidence, call on 09.11.2026.
hearings.note: Sunitha injunction - IA 402 DISMISSED. Madam held the 'headroom' is not a floor and no prima facie case of violation. Bad. Told Sunitha garu we will file the appeal (CMA) well in time, not to worry. Sai - apply for certified copy tomorrow itself and compute limitation for CMA before Chief Judge. Construction will go faster now.

action_items.task: apply for certified copy of order in I.A. 402/2025
compute limitation and draft C.M.A. against order dt. 08.09.2026

hearings.client_interaction: Told client: 'we will file the appeal (C.M.A.) well in time, don't worry'.
